name: Quantum Motion
description: Quantum Motion is a UK quantum computing company developing silicon-based quantum processors using industry-standard 300mm CMOS fabrication technology. Founded by researchers from UCL and the University of Oxford, the company delivered the first full-stack silicon CMOS quantum computer to the UK National Quantum Computing Centre and was advanced to DARPA QBI Stage B in 2025.

products.name: Silicon CMOS Quantum Processor
products.description: Quantum computing processors fabricated on industry-standard 300mm CMOS silicon technology for scalable qubit architectures

highlights: Delivered the first full-stack silicon CMOS quantum computer to the UK National Quantum Computing Centre
Advanced to DARPA Quantum Benchmarking Initiative Stage B in 2025
Raised USD 160M Series C in May 2026 co-led by DCVC and Kembara, positioning it as the UK's best-funded quantum company

news.title: DARPA Advances Quantum Motion to QBI Stage B
news.excerpt: DARPA advanced the company to QBI Stage B in November 2025, one of just 11 companies to progress, on a finding that the silicon-based fault-tolerant design was credible.

news.title: Quantum Motion Raises $160 Million Series C
news.excerpt: Quantum Motion raised $160 million in Series C funding to advance its silicon-based quantum computing platform toward commercial deployment. The round is co-led by DCVC and Kembara, with participation from the British Business Bank and Firgun.

news.title: Quantum Motion Delivers Full-Stack Silicon CMOS Quantum Computer to UK's NQCC
news.excerpt: Quantum Motion has delivered a full-stack quantum computer built using standard silicon CMOS chip fabrication to the UK National Quantum Computing Centre, the first silicon spin-qubit computer installed at the Centre.

news.title: Quantum Motion raises USD 160M Series C led by EU Scaleup Europe Fund
news.excerpt: The EU's new Scaleup Europe Fund made its first major late-stage investment by leading a USD 160M Series C in Quantum Motion, the UK silicon CMOS spin-qubit company. The round follows Quantum Motion's delivery of a full-stack silicon CMOS quantum computer to the UK NQCC and advancement to DARPA QBI Stage B.

news.title: Quantum Motion raises USD 160M Series C to scale silicon spin qubit processors
news.excerpt: The round, co-led by DCVC and Kembara with participation from the British Business Bank, Firgun, Bosch Ventures, Porsche SE, and returning investors, makes Quantum Motion the UK's best-funded quantum company. Funds will scale the 300mm CMOS silicon spin qubit platform toward utility-scale commercial deployment.

news.title: Quantum Motion closes $160M Series C to commercialise silicon CMOS quantum computers for data centres
news.excerpt: DCVC and Kembara co-led Quantum Motion's £120M Series C ($160M), joined by the British Business Bank, Oxford Science Enterprises, Bosch Ventures, Porsche Automobil Holding, Inkef, and Parkwalk Advisors. The round makes Quantum Motion the UK's best-funded quantum computing firm and will fund commercialisation of silicon transistor-based quantum computers that fit in standard data centre racks with 1,000× lower energy use.
